combatrollextension.server.rolling_requi: When true, stamina must be above 0 for rolling.

When true, stamina must be above ('generic.roll_stamina_cost' * 'global_rolling_stamina_cost_multiplier') for rolling.
Has no effect when the above option is set to false.
combatrollextension.server.global_rollin: The stamina cost determined by the 'generic.roll_stamina_cost' attribute is multiplied by this value.
combatrollextension.server.is_roll_invul:
When true, invulnerable ticks on roll are determined by the attribute 'generic.roll_invulnerable_ticks'.
This overrides the 'invulnerable_ticks_upon_roll' setting in the combat roll server config.
